news.title: Daily pass: 415 verified additions (R5250–R5664), 12 from the review list
news.detail: Retry list first: all 141 leads retried again (OpenAlex locations, DOI registries, direct re-read with PDF text extraction, Wayback captures, DOAJ, DSpace/NVA/DiVA/theses.fr APIs, CiNii, NDL/DNB/BnF catalogues, Open Library, Internet Archive, Google Books, DataCite, Semantic Scholar as aggregator only); 12 promoted (R5250–R5261): twelve leads opened by routes not used before or by different captures: Wayback copies of repository records and PDFs (Ecuadorean university theses on pervious concrete and recycled glass, a KAIST pumping thesis, a University of Michigan DeepBlue record, a Springer 2007 self-healing conference paper, Boynton's lime/limestone book page), archived TRID records (Westergaard 1927 pavement temperature stresses, Packard 1984 thickness design, a 2018 Kansas QC/QA report), a DergiPark article page, an EPN repository record and the ACI abstracts-portal page of a 1983 slag/fly-ash admixture paper. 146 leads stay on the review list (129 carried over, 17 new from discovery). The open queue was empty. Discovery (OpenAlex backfill of the least-covered topics: oil-well/geothermal cements, special binders (CSA, CAC, rapid-set, expansive, magnesium phosphate), magnesium and carbonatable binders, calcined clays and LC3, mass concrete/RCC, cellular concrete, heavyweight/shielding concrete, shotcrete, blended cements, white cement and masonry mortars, lightweight concrete, natural pozzolans and international cement industries; historical searches back to the 1960s, 21 language-filtered sweeps and a current-awareness sweep through Nov 27) checked 424 leads and added 403 verified sources, 61 non-English records (English title glosses) and 60 dated 2026 or later. Mostly DOI/abstract or record-page level, not full-text reviews. The unpublished Nov 26 pass (R4909–R5249) is published in the same bundle. Review list: https://xxdccole.github.io/Type1L-Index/review/

change.entry: Daily pass 2026-11-27: 415 verified additions R5250–R5664. Retry list first: 141 leads retried, 12 promoted (R5250–R5261), 129 still unavailable (lastTried 2026-11-27, attempts +1). Open queue: empty at start. Discovery: 424 new leads checked — 403 promoted (R5262–R5664), 17 qualified-but-unavailable added to the review list, 4 rejected (off-topic asphalt-concrete and piezoelectric-sensor items), 44 hits excluded at screening as off-topic, 0 left open. No corrections to existing records. R1–R5249 preserved (R428 still retired); topic membership union maintained; reactions table, calculator, prices and DOT QPL pages untouched. This bundle also carries the Nov 26 pass (R4909–R5249), which had been applied to the working files but not published.

gap: Daily pass 2026-11-27: additions are registry/catalogue/record-page verified (139 abstract-level, 233 DOI metadata only, 34 record pages or PDFs read incl. Wayback copies, 9 library catalogue records) — not full-text reviewed; most Elsevier items are DOI metadata only because Crossref/OpenAlex carry no abstract. 146 qualified leads remain on the review list (research/review-retry.md; https://xxdccole.github.io/Type1L-Index/review/): KDOT PQL documents and special provisions with no archive copy, TRID-only records, CNKI/CQVIP and J-GLOBAL records, Polish BazTech records, theses on unreachable repositories, Spanish/French/Indonesian/Chinese repository items and unregistered DOIs. Some 2026-2027 dates are Crossref issue dates ahead of today. Non-English additions carry title-level English glosses only. Coverage of the least-covered topics is deeper but still foundational (binder-well, binder-specialty, concrete-heavyweight and concrete-mass-rcc remain under 150 records each).

takeaways.binder-well: Nov 27 backfill: oil-well cement slurry rheology, retarders (including 2020–2024 polycarboxylate retarder work), gas migration, chemical shrinkage (1995), foamed cement for fragile formations (1985) and a 1964 cement–pipe bonding study; cement-sheath integrity, plugging-and-abandonment alternatives, and 2026 papers on sea-water/gypsum hydration, high-density slurries, CO2 corrosion and AFt seeding at 5 °C (R5321–R5648, 28 records). DOI/abstract level only.
takeaways.binder-specialty: Nov 27 backfill: calcium sulfoaluminate (CSA) cement hydration and CSA–belite synthesis, CSA–Portland blends, magnesium phosphate cements (struvite-K formation, Mg/P ratio effects), plus Spanish, French and Chinese-language CSA sources (SAC pavement use, JC/T standards) (R5310–R5603, 19 records). DOI/abstract or record-page level only.
takeaways.binder-magnesium-carbonatable: Nov 27 backfill: magnesium silicate hydrate (M-S-H) cements from 1992 to 2020 (low-pH systems, rice-husk-ash mixes, 3D printing), reactive magnesia and carbonation curing reviews, CO2-mineralised wastes as SCMs, and 2026 MOC / basic magnesium sulfate cement studies (R5280–R5606, 30 records). DOI/abstract level only.
takeaways.scm-clay: Nov 27 backfill: metakaolin concrete (ASR, shrinkage, elevated temperature), calcined mixed-layer clays, kaolinite dissolution kinetics, brick/ceramic powder replacement, and many limestone calcined clay cement (LC3) papers on hydration, rheology, ECC/SHCC and machine-learning strength prediction (R5263–R5631, 55 records). DOI/abstract level only.
takeaways.concrete-mass-rcc: Nov 27 backfill: thermal cracking and temperature control of mass concrete (pipe cooling, FE models, ANN forecasts), RCC arch-dam monitoring, Japanese Concrete Institute annual-paper records on mass concrete and dam pre-cooling with liquid nitrogen (1987–2007), and Brazilian thermomechanical studies for gravity dams (R5373–R5660, 29 records). DOI/abstract or catalogue level only.
takeaways.concrete-cellular: Nov 27 backfill: autoclaved aerated concrete (tobermorite formation, waste-based raw materials, thermal conductivity), foamed concrete with fly ash, slag, bottom ash and fibres, and Indonesian, Turkish, Spanish and records from Russian journals (R5343–R5663, 47 records). DOI/abstract or record-page level only.
takeaways.concrete-heavyweight: Nov 27 backfill: magnetite concrete for radiation shielding (1949), X-ray attenuation in concrete (1955), water content of concrete shields (1967), and boron/ferro-boron, bronze-doped, steel-slag and tourmaline heavyweight concretes for gamma and neutron shielding (R5355–R5650, 18 records). DOI/abstract level only.
takeaways.concrete-shotcrete: Nov 27 backfill: wet-mix shotcrete rheology, pumpability and rebound (including a 1998 mechanics-of-rebound paper), accelerators and sulfate durability, fibre-reinforced and sprayed ECC, tunnel-lining analyses, and 2026 low-rebound and self-healing shotcrete studies (R5385–R5659, 36 records). DOI/abstract level only.
takeaways.binder-blended: Nov 27 backfill: Portland-composite cements with metakaolin, slag, steel slag and fly ash (hydration, chloride binding, steam curing), ternary blends and biochar composites (R5262–R5647, 23 records). DOI/abstract level only.
takeaways.binder-white-masonry: Nov 27 backfill: ASTM C1437 flow-of-mortar editions (2015 and 2020), white Portland cement hydration and C-S-H with metakaolin, historic brick–lime mortars and plasters, Boynton's lime and limestone book, and cement-mortar permeability and carbonation studies (R5255–R5655, 19 records). DOI/abstract or record-page level only.
takeaways.binder-cac-csa: Nov 27 backfill: high-alumina (calcium aluminate) cement conversion, strätlingite formation, accelerators and retarders (1978–1993), 1971 French electron-microscopy hydration studies, supersulfated cements and refractory castable binders (R5272–R5654, 37 records). DOI/abstract level only.
takeaways.binder-lc3: Nov 27 backfill: LC3 C-A-S-H composition, thixotropy, ASR mitigation, 3D-printed LC3 mortar, ECC with LC3 and 2024–2026 durability, mix-design and foam-concrete papers (R5288–R5631, 32 records). DOI/abstract level only.
takeaways.concrete-lightweight: Nov 27 backfill: structural lightweight aggregate concrete (sintered fly ash, expanded clay, oil-palm-shell aggregate), thermal conductivity and thermal-bridging studies, and German-language records from 1972 to 2008 on lightweight and aerogel concrete (R5294–R5664, 41 records). DOI/abstract level only.
takeaways.scm-natural: Nov 27 backfill: natural pozzolans (volcanic ash, trass, pumice) in high-volume blends, durability and LCA, ancient Roman seawater concretes (Soli-Pompeiopolis Phlegrean pozzolan) and 2026 Roman-concrete lessons paper (R5265–R5664, 24 records). DOI/abstract or record-page level only.
takeaways.binder-international: Nov 27 backfill: Indian cement industry energy-efficiency and decarbonisation studies, low-clinker ternary blends for India, Brazilian phosphogypsum retarder and Portland cement/admixture history, and lime-sludge clinker production (R5282–R5494, 11 records). DOI/abstract level only.
